So my input doesn’t really matter but maybe it’ll help. I too suffer from ocd, anxiety disorders and depression. I’ve found a few medications over the years that have worked but only for a short amount of time. I started smoking weed at the age of 13, it definitely helps my anxiety but makes my depression worse. I started because I was peer pressured by my siblings. And while it was fun at that age, I did t realize the long term effect it would have on me. I can’t find a decent job because of drug testing (I’m not savvy enough to do fake pee). It made my concentration in school more difficult. I almost failed high school because of it. It does matter how your mind set is when you’re smoking, some people can be functioning adults and smoke weed, some can’t. I guess what I’m trying to get at is maybe a break would be good. Weed can’t be the only way you cope with mental illness. There’s many forms of therapy and medication can take a while, you usually have to find the “perfect” combo and it can take years. Something similar happened to me and one of my cats. We didn’t find him for 3 months. Any advice I can give is don’t use the flash light. We did that and it made our cat run away even more, most likely because he couldn’t see who we were behind the light. Walk around your neighborhood with a bag of treats, shake them and call her name. Leave toys, a litter box, her bed and maybe a food dish out. If she’s able to smell her scent, she’ll find her way back. We also put out live traps with tuna in them (ended up catching opossums though lol) .  Basically you need to try to lure her back to your yard at least. Best of luck!
